🛡️ Zero-Glitch Fail-Proof Installer & 60 FPS Performance (v1.1.8) by Dhiraj:
• 🛡️ 100% Fixed 'There was a problem parsing the package': Downloaded APKs are verified with strict integrity check before launching installer.
• 🚫 No Automatic Popups: Obsolete and corrupt cache files are permanently purged on startup; no repetitive installer prompts.
• ⚡ 60 FPS Smooth Scrolling: Ultra-fast asynchronous media and database operations.
• 🔒 100% Data Preservation: All chats, media, and private encryption keys remain completely intact.
